sentences.ar: صاروا يدوروا شو يعني رقم اتنين.
sentences.en: They began working out what number two meant.
It turned out to be a room in an inn in the town.

sentences.ar: هَك قرر يراقب النزل كل ليلة.
sentences.en: Huck decided to watch the inn every night.
He would sleep among the barrels and wait.

sentences.ar: بعد أيام، شاف جو طالع بالليل.
sentences.en: After days, he saw Joe going out at night.
He followed him quietly between the houses.
